name: shopify-multi-store-mcp-server
description: Multi-store Shopify Admin MCP server for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code. Search products, compare inventory and catalogs, run reports, and make guarded updates.

AUDIT_DB.description: D1 database for the audit log (shopify-multi-store-audit). The Deploy to Cloudflare flow creates it. With the CLI, create it first with `npx wrangler d1 create shopify-multi-store-audit` and put its database_id in wrangler.jsonc; see docs/DEPLOY-CLOUDFLARE.md.

OAUTH_STORE.description: Durable Object holding OAuth clients, codes, token hashes and encrypted Shopify tokens. Created from the migration in wrangler.jsonc.

SHOPIFY_APP_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your Shopify app (Dev Dashboard, app settings).

SHOPIFY_APP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your Shopify app. Also verifies Shopify's callback signature.

SHOPIFY_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEYS.description: k1: followed by 32 random bytes in base64, for example the output of: echo k1:$(openssl rand -base64 32). Encrypts stored Shopify tokens; keep it.

STORES_JSON.description: The stores this Worker serves, for example {"stores":[{"alias":"main","shop":"main-store.myshopify.com"}]}
